rate_limits: Plus plan: maximum 100 concurrent transcription requests across HTTP and WebSocket interfaces combined.
description: IBM Watson Speech to Text converts audio to written text. It provides real-time WebSocket streaming and synchronous or asynchronous HTTP transcription, plus speaker labels and custom language models. Current large speech and next-generation models do not support acoustic-model customization. Common uses include transcription, live captions, voice interfaces, and speech analytics. Access is through IBM Cloud IAM credentials and region-specific endpoints.
